name: Low-Head Gravity Dam
title: Low-Head Gravity Dam
description: Low-Head Gravity Dam is a complete gravity dam blueprint record in this database, covering the full plan set from site layout to final details. Taught at ladder rank 1 of 20 (Foundations): core concepts, parts, and safe building practices.
